title: ArcFarms large floor event refinement and Crystal activation compatibility 2026-10-24
assumptions: This is a refinement of already existing floor events and a Crystal activation correction; it does not add a reward, order, resource quantity, multiplier or item.

Low/base/high are assumptions: 0.25/1/2 active hours per player-day, 3/6/10 shifts per hour, 5/10/20 eligible contributors. The unchanged direct completion payouts are kept outside the zero incremental event-flow calculation.

Freight transfer animation changes from 2 to 4 seconds; all four durable steps remain. Pump keeps six steps and its drain timing. Longer transfer cannot increase the nominal event throughput; actual completion cadence is unmeasured.

Crystal restores reachable execution of the existing once-only <=4 shared order-credit mechanic; credits are quota progress, not inventory items or currency. Fixed wall selection may restore practical throughput, but no frequency/rate is asserted.

Completion payout remains268-284Vault,402-426vanillaXP and one existing exclusive weighted resource bundle per positive contributor, cooldown60seconds. Party/alt reward rules and native mining guards remain.
SELL is the current alternative conversion for existing bundle items; SELL-to-contract transition remains a future scenario. No new saleable item or conversion route exists in this refinement.

flows.source: existing MineFloorActivities / MineCrystalResonanceIncident canonical shift progress; no grant added
